jobs.title: Implementation Consultant I
jobs.description:
R1 is the leading provider of technology\-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems, and physician groups. We combine deep healthcare expertise, a global workforce, and advanced capabilities across analytics, AI, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration to help healthcare organizations improve performance at scale.


As an Implementation Consultant I, you will support the deployment and implementation of the Entri Product Suite, working with clients and internal hospital operations, application, and infrastructure teams to design, build, test, and launch patient and user experience solutions. This entry\-level role within Configuration and Deployment initially supports a limited product scope, with the opportunity and expectation to learn and progress quickly.


You will help move projects from planning through go\-live by gathering client data and requirements, supporting application database builds, coordinating testing and readiness activities, developing educational materials, and keeping stakeholders informed and accountable. This is a strong opportunity for someone who is organized, proactive, client\-focused, eager to learn, and comfortable solving workflow and implementation challenges in a collaborative environment.


**Responsibilities**

* Partner with clients and internal hospital operations, application, and infrastructure teams to support the design, build, and implementation of Entri patient and user experience solutions.
* Support on\-time, accurate delivery of application database builds and communicate progress, risks, and support needs across the deployment team.
* Consult with clients and project partners to define and obtain the data needed to configure applications based on contract scope, client needs, project timelines, and budget.
* Analyze data and operational workflows to identify standard best practices, improve efficiency, and solve implementation challenges creatively.
* Coordinate with clients, Operations, Training, IT, Product, Integration, Support, and other project partners to meet implementation milestones and prepare for go\-live.
* Develop and deliver clear training, objectives, expectations, and educational materials for end users and project stakeholders.
* Lead or support database validation, functional testing, and integrated testing to confirm readiness for successful go\-lives.
* Identify project obstacles, engage the appropriate subject matter experts, and escalate or resolve issues that could affect solution delivery.
* Provide clear project updates and escalations to stakeholders at multiple levels and help maintain accountability throughout implementation.
* Propose opportunities to improve, enhance, or expand product and process initiatives.
* Build knowledge of healthcare operations and patient access workflows while progressing through product training, mock implementation work, shadowing, and supported client projects.
* Travel to client sites based on project needs, with the ability to travel up to 50%.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 1\-3 years of related experience in healthcare, technology, implementation, deployment, project coordination, configuration, client service, or a related field.
* Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio.
* Highly organized, with strong interpersonal skills and clear, concise oral and written communication.
* Ability to present information effectively and respond to questions from managers, clients, office staff, peers, and other stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and critical\-thinking skills, including the ability to collect information, establish facts, draw conclusions, and correct errors.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, work effectively under pressure, and adjust to rapidly changing customer needs.
* Self\-motivation and the ability to work independently without close supervision while contributing effectively within a collaborative team.
* Ability to handle confidential information with integrity and understand the importance of protecting patient data, including HIPAA requirements.
* Ability to understand, read, write, and speak English and prepare professional business correspondence.
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% based on project needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Healthcare experience, particularly in patient access, registration, scheduling, hospital operations, or related workflows.
* Experience supporting software implementation, product deployment, application configuration, database build, or project management activities.
* Experience with healthcare platforms or electronic medical record systems such as Epic or Cerner.
* Experience with Schedule Maximizer, Order Facilitator, Consumer Self Scheduling, Looker Reporting, or related Entri tools.
* Comfort working directly with clients, facilitating meetings, delivering demonstrations or training, and navigating challenging stakeholder interactions.
* Ability to learn new products and processes quickly, ask thoughtful clarifying questions, apply constructive feedback, and remain effective through a steep learning curve.
* Collaborative, energetic approach with a focus on team success, continuous learning, and professional growth.

For this US\-based position, the base pay range is $54,661\.00 \- $85,842\.89 per year . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
The healthcare system is always evolving — and it’s up to us to use our shared expertise to find new solutions that can keep up. On our growing team you’ll find the opportunity to constantly learn, collaborate across groups and explore new paths for your career.  



  

Our associates are given the chance to contribute, think boldly and create meaningful work that makes a difference in the communities we serve around the world. We go beyond expectations in everything we do. Not only does that drive customer success and improve patient care, but that same enthusiasm is applied to giving back to the community and taking care of our team — including offering a competitive benefits package.

Furthermore, the Company is dedicated to providing a workplace free from harassment based on any of the foregoing protected categories.

**Job Description:**


Job Description
Qualifacts is a leading provider of behavioral health software and SaaS solutions for clinical productivity, compliance and state reporting, billing, and business intelligence. Its mission is to be an innovative and trusted technology and end\-to\-end solutions partner, enabling exceptional outcomes for its customers and those they serve. Qualifacts’ comprehensive portfolio, including the CareLogic®, Credible™, and InSync® platforms, spans and serves the entire behavioral health, rehabilitative, and human services market supporting non\-profit Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHC) as well as for\-profit large enterprise and small business providers. Qualifacts has a loyal customer base, with more than 2,500 customers representing 75,000 providers serving more than 6 million patients. Qualifacts was recognized in the 2022 and 2023 Best in KLAS: Software and Services report as having the top ranked Behavioral Health EHR solutions.


If you want to work inside an atmosphere where innovation has purpose, and your ambition works to support our customers and those they serve, please apply today!

**We are seeking candidates in Nashville or Tampa to work a hybrid schedule in either office location. Remote candidates will not be considered.**

**Summary of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**


We are seeking a Clinical Implementation Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in guiding new customers through the entire implementation lifecycle of our healthcare technology solutions. This position requires a blend of clinical expertise, technical knowledge, and exceptional communication skills to ensure successful adoption and compliance with state and reporting requirements.

**Responsibilities for the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Assess clinical practices, state reporting, and patient treatment requirements; develop collaborative solutions and present recommendations
* Lead new customer implementations from kickoff through go\-live, ensuring a smooth and efficient process
* Resolve client inquiries promptly, maintaining ownership through resolution
* Maintain project documentation and communicate updates via agendas, minutes, and project management tools
* Build and sustain positive, productive relationships with customers and internal teams
* Apply consultative techniques to identify configuration requirements and implement best practices
* Review and validate software configurations with customer implementation teams
* Ensure quality of configured features and prepare customers for effective end\-user training
* Complete product training and demonstrate adaptability across multiple EHR platforms
* Creatively resolve and assess a wide range of issues, suggesting alternative approaches as needed
* Document and track all customer state and reporting requirements to ensure compliance
* Record all customer interactions in CRM according to established standards
* Participate in on\-site visits as needed to gather data and understand workflows

**Qualifications of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* Clinical experience in behavioral health or general healthcare
* SaaS/cloud implementation experience; EHR/EMR experience preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Strong remote collaboration skills
* Data visualization and reporting analysis expertise
* Familiarity with CCBHC and state\-specific clinical requirements (NY or CA preferred)
* Knowledge of HIPAA compliance
* Exceptional customer service and communication skills (written \& oral)
* Quick, logical problem\-solving with attention to detail and follow\-through
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to travel up to 25%

Qualifacts is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist**
=============================

**About the Role**
------------------


Prospyr is looking for an **Implementation Specialist** to help new customers successfully transition onto Prospyr and get their teams operational as quickly and confidently as possible.


You’ll own the implementation process from post\-sale handoff through go\-live, coordinating configuration, data migration, workflows, training, and launch readiness.


This role is highly project\-oriented. You'll manage multiple implementations simultaneously while working closely with customers and internal teams to keep projects organized, remove blockers, and ensure customers are prepared to operate successfully in Prospyr.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Implementation Project Management**

* Own customer implementations from Sales handoff through successful go\-live.
* Build and manage implementation plans, milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Coordinate customer and internal stakeholders throughout the project.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early and drive them toward resolution.
* Maintain clear communication around project status and next steps.

### **Platform Configuration**

* Guide customers through configuration of their Prospyr environment.
* Help customers translate existing operational workflows into Prospyr.
* Coordinate setup across areas such as:


	+ Providers and staff
	+ Locations
	+ Scheduling
	+ Services and catalog
	+ Forms and consents
	+ Payments
	+ Patient communications
	+ Inventory
	+ Memberships
	+ Online booking
	+ Integrations and other applicable features
* Validate configuration prior to go\-live.

### **Data Migration \& Integrations**

* Coordinate data migration requirements between customers and internal technical teams.
* Help customers understand what data is required and how it should be prepared.
* Track migration progress and validate readiness with the customer.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and dependencies when applicable.
* Escalate technical blockers with clear documentation and business impact.

### **Training \& Go\-Live Readiness**

* Coordinate and deliver role\-based customer training.
* Ensure administrators, providers, front\-desk teams, and other users understand the workflows relevant to their roles.
* Develop a clear go\-live readiness checklist for each implementation.
* Identify knowledge gaps before launch and coordinate additional training where needed.
* Provide additional support during the transition into live operations.

### **Process Improvement**

* Identify recurring implementation friction and opportunities to improve Prospyr's onboarding process.
* Help develop implementation templates, playbooks, checklists, documentation, and training resources.
* Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring implementation blockers.
* Help move repeatable onboarding activities toward scalable self\-service experiences.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Customers launch on time with minimal disruption to their businesses.
* Implementation timelines and responsibilities are clear to customers and internal teams.
* Data migration and configuration issues are identified before go\-live.
* Customers enter ongoing CX management with strong platform knowledge and clearly defined workflows.
* Time\-to\-value and time\-to\-go\-live improve as implementation processes become more standardized.
* Fewer post\-launch support issues originate from incomplete configuration or training.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2–4\+ years of SaaS implementation, onboarding, project management, or customer success experience.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
* Comfortable learning complex software and becoming highly proficient in product configuration.
* Strong customer communication and training skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot problems and coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where processes continue to evolve.
* Healthcare, EMR, medical aesthetics, wellness, payments, or vertical SaaS experience is a plus.

**Role Philosophy**
-------------------


Implementation owns the question:

**“What needs to happen to get this customer successfully live on Prospyr?”**


The Implementation Specialist drives that process from beginning to end, while creating a clean transition to the CXM who will own the customer's long\-term success.

jobs.description:
**Ameris Bank** is a purpose\-driven company, dedicated to bringing financial peace of mind to communities, one person at a time. Whether a customer wants to grow their business, buy a home, or feel confident in their retirement plan, they have a partner in Ameris Bank. We serve customers in our locations across the Southeast, Mid\-Atlantic and nationwide through our extensive digital offerings and mobile app.  



  

Delivering financial peace of mind starts with a team that values integrity and rewards ingenuity. At Ameris, you’ll find teammates who are inclusive, collaborative problem\-solvers who go the extra mile to support one another and to meet every customer’s needs. When teammates are empowered and bring their diverse perspectives to the table, we create the best possible outcomes for our customers. At Ameris, we know that a growth mindset is key for high performance and fosters an environment that prioritizes continuous improvement. Teammates have access to Employee Resource Groups that serve as advocates and purpose and how you can bring it to life as an Ameris Bank teammate.


**Job Summary**

The Loan Documentation Quality and Training Specialist serves as the subject matter expert and product owner for loan documentation, with primary responsibility for developing, delivering, and reinforcing training for Loan Closers and related stakeholders. This role coordinates, prepares, and reviews complex, high\-dollar commercial loan transactions to ensure accuracy and compliance with loan approval requirements, bank policy, procedures, regulations, and applicable laws. This role also partners with Loan Operations/Hub, Lending, Credit, attorneys, third\-party vendors, and other business partners to support consistent execution of loan documentation requirements and complex commercial loan closings.


**Essential Functions, Duties and Responsibilities**

* Develops, delivers, and maintains ongoing loan documentation and closing\-related training for Loan Closers and other stakeholders to promote adherence to best practices, policy, procedures, regulatory requirements, and technology/process changes.
* Reviews completed and in\-process loan closings to identify documentation discrepancies, policy exceptions, process gaps, and training opportunities; documents findings and uses results to support targeted coaching and continuous improvement.
* Serves as the subject matter expert for loan documentation and complex closing requirements, providing guidance to commercial loan hub closers, and supervisors.
* Reviews loan type, approval terms and conditions, bank policy, and regulatory requirements to determine closing requirements and support accurate due diligence and closing checklists.
* Supports large, complex, and specialized commercial loan closings by reviewing legal closing documents, third\-party reports, entity documents, title, surveys, flood determinations, UCC searches, and other required diligence items for accuracy and sufficiency.
* Identifies discrepancies and complex closing issues, researches root causes, facilitates resolution, and recommends corrective actions.
* Analyzes loan closing processes, and implements continuous improvements to strengthen operational effectiveness, quality, and consistency.
* Represents the Commercial Loan Hub department in cross\-functional initiatives, workflow changes, and other process improvement efforts related to loan closing and documentation.
* Reviews regulatory and policy changes to assess impacts to the loan closing process and updates training, procedures, and communication materials as appropriate.
* Researches special topics, prepares findings, and provides recommendations based on risk, operational impact, and business needs.
* Maintains clear, professional communication with lenders, borrowers, attorneys, vendors, and internal partners regarding closing requirements, issue resolution, status updates, and process expectations.
* Supports timely completion of closing requirements, workflow management, electronic file organization, checklist maintenance, disbursement processing, service level expectations, and quality control objectives as needed.

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Competencies**

* Specialized, in\-depth knowledge of commercial loan closing, loan documentation, regulatory requirements, bank policy, procedures, and best practices.
* Thorough knowledge of standard and non\-standard loan products, business entities, financial covenants, due diligence requirements, and document storage or loan documentation systems.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver effective training, coaching, communication, and process adoption support for operational teams and business partners.
* Advanced research, analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills, including the ability to identify viable options, assess risk, draw sound conclusions, and present thoughtful recommendations.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex loan approvals, credit write\-ups, legal documents, third\-party reports, and closing requirements.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to express information clearly, professionally, and persuasively.
* Ability to negotiate, drive consensus, maintain collaborative relationships, and manage or resolve conflict across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, detailed information, electronic files, and high\-volume workloads while producing accurate, high\-quality work.
* Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office Suite and banking or loan\-related software applications.
* Ability to perform accurate calculations, transactions, and documentation reviews.

**Industry and Work Experience**

* 6 or more years of loan closing and/or processing experience required.
* Experience using relevant storage software applications required.
* Experience managing projects required.

* Bachelor’s degree required.

jobs.title: MEDICAL RECORDS TECH (Health Information Technician)
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


This position is located in the Health Information Management (HIM) section within the Heath Administration Service at the Jonathan M. Wainwright VA Medical Center. MRTs HIT perform incomplete health record analysis. They review, analyze, abstract, maintain, extract, and compile information from the health record. MRTs HIT check for accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of the health record and monitor and report for regulatory compliance.  

  

  



Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
  
**Duties**
----------


* Reviews health records to ensure that all records contain sufficient information to meet medical/legal requirements, to ensure continuity of patient care, and to support education and research needs.
* Assists clinicians with completion of delinquent/incomplete health records.
* Performs the quantitative and qualitative analysis on both computer and paper based health records.
* Consults with the appropriate clinician(s) for clarification when conflicting or ambiguous information appears in the health record documentation.
* Identifies health record deficiencies, tracks deficiencies and ensures that the appropriate individual completes their deficiencies.
* Assists physicians with the completion of delinquent/incomplete health records.
* Expediting the completion of the health record when the patient is transferred for care at another medical center, for legal requests, regulatory agencies review, and reimbursement purposes.
* Assesses the paper health record and electronic Computerized Patient Record System (CPRS) for completeness and notes deficiencies.
* Tracks electronic signatures and documents deficiencies and communicates these deficiencies to clinical staff for correction.
* Prepares complex weekly and monthly reports noting the status of all incomplete/delinquent records and compliance reports and submits the reports to the appropriate administrative and clinical staff.
* Performs analytical tasks associated with the resolution of "filing" errors on reports uploaded by a transcription vendor.
* Compares and resolves discrepancies between daily Gains and Losses Sheet, Digital System.
* Reviews health records for adherence with guidelines related to resident supervision and attending physician presence.
* Works with interdisciplinary staff to solve problems regarding proper health record documentation and completion.
* Develops and compiles written reports trending provider specific, service, and hospital compliance reports regarding admission subsequent and discharge notes.
* Reviews health records for adherence with guidelines related to resident supervision and attending physician presence.
* Works with interdisciplinary staff to solve problems regarding proper health record documentation and completion.

**Work Schedule**: Monday\-Friday 8am\-4:30pm  

**Recruitment/Relocation Incentives (Sign\-on Bonus):** Not Authorized  

**Pay:** Competitive salary and regular salary increases.  

**Paid Time Off:** 37\-50 days of annual paid time offer per year (13\-26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year)  

**Parental Leave:** After 12 months of employment, up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave in connection with the birth, adoption, or foster care placement of a child.  

**Child Care Subsidy:** After 60 days of employment, full time employees with a total family income below $144,000 may be eligible for a childcare subsidy up to 25% of total eligible childcare costs for eligible children up to the monthly maximum of $416\.66**.**  

**Retirement:** Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA**Insurance:** Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long\-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement)  

**Telework**: Not available  

**Virtual:** This is not a virtual position.  

**Functional Statement \#**: 000000  

**Permanent Change of Station (PCS):** Not authorized
  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


* You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job.
* Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959\.
* Must be proficient in written and spoken English.
* Subject to background/security investigation.
* Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process. Acceptable form(s) of identification will be required to complete pre\-employment requirements (https://www.uscis.gov/i\-9\-central/form\-i\-9\-acceptable\-documents). Effective May 7, 2025, driver's licenses or state\-issued identification cards that are not REAL ID compliant cannot be utilized as an acceptable form of identification for employment.
* Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP).
* Complete all application requirements detailed in the "Required Documents" section of this announcement.

As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 1 or 2\-year trial period during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, we may consider:
* your performance and conduct;
* the needs and interests of the agency;
* whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and
* whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service.

Upon completion of your trial period, your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.
### **Qualifications**


Applicants pending the completion of educational or certification/licensure requirements may be referred and tentatively selected but may not be hired until all requirements are met.  

  

**Basic Requirements**:


* **United States Citizenship**: Non\-citizens may only be appointed when it is not possible to recruit qualified citizens in accordance with VA Policy.
* **English Language Proficiency:** MRTs HIT must be proficient in spoken and written English, as required by 38 U.S.C. § 7403(f).
* **Experience/Education:**
	+ **Experience:** One year of creditable experience that indicates knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, and a general understanding of health records. Six months of the required one year of creditable experience must have provided the knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSAs) needed to perform MRT HIT work. **OR**
	+ **Education:** An associate's degree from an accredited college or university recognized by the U.S. Department of Education, with a major field of study in health information technology/health information management, or a related degree with a minimum of 12 semester hours in health information technology/health information management (e.g., courses in medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, legal aspects of health care, and introduction to health records). **OR**
	+ **Experience/Education Combination:** Equivalent combinations of creditable experience and education are qualifying towards meeting basic experience requirements. The following educational/training substitutions are appropriate for combining education and creditable experience:
		- Six months of creditable experience that indicates knowledge of medicalterminology, privacy and release of information, the health record, and one yearabove high school with a minimum of six semester hours of health informationtechnology/health information management.
		- Six months of creditable experience that indicates knowledge of medicalterminology, privacy and release of information, the health record, and successfulcompletion of a course for medical technicians, hospital corpsmen, medicalservice specialists, or hospital training obtained in a training program given bythe U.S. Armed Forces or the U.S. Maritime Service, under close medical andprofessional supervision, may be substituted on a month\-for\-month basis for upto six months of experience, provided the training program included courses inanatomy, physiology, and health record techniques and procedures.

May qualify based on being covered by the Grandfathering Provision as described in the VA Qualification Standard for this occupation (only applicable to current VHA employees who are in this occupation and meet the criteria).  

  

Grandfathering Provision: All persons employed in VHA as a MRT HIT, on the effective date of this qualification standard, are considered to have met all qualification requirements for the grade held, including positive education and licensure/certification/registration that are part of the basic requirements of the occupation.  

  

**Grade Determinations**:**GS\-4 (Entry Level):** None beyond basic requirements.  

  

**GS\-5 (Developmental Level 1\):** One year of experience equivalent to the next lower level. **OR**  

A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university recognized by the U.S. Department of Education with a major field of study in health information management, or a related degree with a minimum of 24 semester hours in health information technology/health information management (e.g., courses in medical terminology, anatomy \& physiology, legal aspects of health care, and introduction to health records).In addition to the experience above, the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs:
* Ability to communicate effectively with internal and external customers.
* Ability to utilize health information technology and various office software products used in health information management positions (e.g., Microsoft Excel, electronic health records, and delinquency tracking software).
* Knowledge of health record documentation guidelines and industry standards.
* Ability to manage priorities and coordinate work to complete duties within required timeframes.
* Ability to apply knowledge of medical terminology and human anatomy to fully understand the content of a health record.


  

**GS\-6 (Developmental level):** One year of experience equivalent to the next lower grade level.In addition to the experience above, the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs:
* Ability to navigate efficiently through the health record to locate needed information.
* Ability to analyze health record documentation to ensure compliance with guidelines and industry standards.
* Skill in investigating potential health record errors and making corrections, when appropriate.
* Skill in interpreting and applying health information guidelines and using judgment to complete assignments.
* Ability to follow up on incomplete health record documentation.


  

**GS\-7 (Full Performance Level):** One year of experience equivalent to the next lower grade level.In addition to the experience above, the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs:
* Ability to judge whether health records contain sufficient information for regulatory requirements, are acceptable as legal documents, are adequate for continuity of patient care, and support education and research needs.
* Ability to take appropriate actions if health record content is not adequate, accurate, timely, and/or reliable.
* Ability to communicate both orally and in writing with individuals or groups, to facilitate compliance with established policies and regulations.
* Skill in using appropriate software and computer applications to analyze and record documentation trends.
* Ability to apply qualitative and/or quantitative methods for assessment and improvement of health records.
* Ability to work independently and utilize problem\-solving techniques in the accomplishment of work.


  

**Reference:** For more information on this qualification standard, please visit https://www.va.gov/ohrm/QualificationStandards/.  

  

The full performance level of this vacancy is GS\-7\. The actual grade at which an applicant may be selected for this vacancy is in the range of GS\-4 to GS\-7\.  

  

There are no physical requirements for this occupation per OCHCO Communications email to VA Handbook 5019, updated on 4/17/2026\.
### **Education**


**Note:** Only education or degrees recognized by the U.S. Department of Education from accredited colleges, universities, schools, or institutions may be used to qualify for Federal employment. You can verify your education here: http://ope.ed.gov/accreditation/. If you are using foreign education to meet qualification requirements, you must send a Certificate of Foreign Equivalency with your transcript in order to receive credit for that education. jobs.description:
**Employment Type:** Hourly  

**Work Arrangement:** Onsite

**Position Summary:**
---------------------


The Plant Training Specialist is responsible for the design, development, and execution of a wide variety of Learning \& Development processes, programs, systems, and performance support materials. This role facilitates and flawlessly executes Learning \& Development events with professionalism, enthusiasm, energy, and precision. Responsibility for functioning as expert user of various Learning \& Development systems such as: LMS, LCMS, Learning Design software, and Project Management software. This role will work cross\-functionally with other departments, facilities, contractors, members of the L\&D Team, and other Key Stakeholders as needed on Enterprise\-Level projects and training rollouts.

**Major Duties and Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------------

* Designs Learning Content that facilitates knowledge transfer (eLearning, Instructor\-Led Training Classes, Virtual Training, Observations, Evaluations, Knowledge Tests, etc.) that is Learner\-Focused, engaging, highly interactive, and easily applied to job functions. Maintains functional\-level knowledge of Learning Development Software (Articulate 360, Alchemy Creator, etc.) and Audio/Video editing software (Adobe, Camtasia, Final Cut Pro, etc.). Utilize knowledge of various Learning Methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, Agile, etc.) to evaluate current training offerings, make necessary enhancements, and develop new learner\-focused training offerings that meet the ever\-changing business needs.
* Work w/ Subject Matter Experts to gather necessary information to revise, create, or enhance performance support documents (SOP's, Job Aids, OPL's, Theory of Operations, etc.) that supports the effective build of learning content. Ability to develop technical skills outside of their comfort level that enhance their ability to facilitate and develop training classes/events.
* Execute the training project life cycle with a high degree of expertise and efficiency from end\-to\-end to include Needs Assessment, Project Charter, budget adherence, project timelines, KPIs, and Measurement and Evaluation (i.e., Kirkpatrick Model).
* Facilitates higher\-level classes in Functional Excellence (Certified Trainer, Chemical Safety Training, Pump/Mill Training) and Leadership Effectiveness (Emerging Leader training, Frontline Leader training). Provides material/expertise for Learning \& Development events that engages and equips the audience and supports the desired outcome.
* Utilize knowledge of A/V equipment, shot composure, lighting, sound, framing, etc. to capture pictures/videos needed to develop training materials. Work with SMEs as needed to capture assets that reinforce company policies and procedures, maintain brand integrity, and bring the training to LIFE.
* Coordinator duties as required.
**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

* High School diploma or equivalent required
* Bachelor's Degree preferred \- equivalent industry\-level certification a plus.
* Minimum of 1 \- 2 years of experience in a professional Learning \& Development role.
* Demonstrated capability of technical expertise (Microsoft Suite, Articulate 360, Adobe Software, etc.), project management capabilities.

-------------------------

* Must possess a functional knowledge of various communication technologies and their applications (video conferencing, web\-conferencing, audience response systems, presentation software, etc.).
* Employee must model the company Core Values of Integrity, Customer Focus, Teamwork, and Personal Ownership, and possess a work history that demonstrates these values.
* Must be a trusted advisor to the organizational levels with whom he/she serves.
* Effective problem\-solving, innovation, and communication skills will lead to success in this role.

Ventura Foods innovates and manufactures food solutions for foodservice and retail businesses. We make exclusive products for the world's most iconic restaurants and retailers, we provide ready\-to\-go product solutions for professional kitchens, and we make consumer brands everyone knows and loves. When you work for Ventura Foods, you get a strong foundation of training, a manager who cares about you and celebrates your success, a safe environment, and challenging work. Ventura Foods conducts regular reviews of compensation ranges and therefore reserves the right to alter this range at any given time.

By fostering a workplace that is supportive, collaborative, and grounded in integrity, we continue to attract strong talent and meet the high expectations of a rapidly evolving marketplace.

jobs.title: Platform Implementation Specialist, Annuities - Vice President
jobs.description:
**About the Role**



iCapital is seeking a Vice President to join its Implementation team as a senior team lead for Annuities. The Implementation team sits within the Product organization and is responsible for managing platform integrations for both new and existing clients as well as managing the ongoing platform experience for existing clients in close partnership with Product Managers and Relationship Managers.


**Responsibilities**


* Drive successful end\-to\-end annuity implementations for new and existing iCapital clients, including broker\-dealers, Independent Marketing Organizations, carriers, and strategic technology partners.
* Provide program and project management expertise including framing the project, establishing detailed project plans, managing risk and driving accountability across internal and external stakeholders.
* Retain an in\-depth understanding of the iCapital annuities platform to lead or facilitate client discovery, requirements gathering, operating model and business process design, platform setup, testing, and rollout.
* Lead integrations involving annuity marketplaces, order entry platforms, eApplication providers, carrier connectivity, holdings integrations, and related annuity workflows.
* Manage the overall platform experience for existing clients, including maximizing adoption and utilization of annuity products and capabilities.
* Build a strong understanding of a client’s business and how that translates to the iCapital platform; Provide Product Managers and other internal stakeholders with client context to assess change management activities including new product enhancements.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to identify product gaps and opportunities, vet potential solutions and roll out new features.
* Partner closely with the Product Management, Relationship Management, Sales, Operations, Client Success, and external technology teams to deliver for clients.


**Qualifications**


* 10\+ years of experience in project management, client software implementations, relationship management within financial services, insurance, annuities, or fintech
* Knowledge of wealth management, insurance distribution, broker\-dealer operations, and annuity business processes
* Knowledge of annuity products, carrier ecosystems, and annuity order entry and eApplication workflows
* Proven track record of leading cross\-functional project teams from inception to execution
* Familiar with software\-based financial solutions (transaction systems, online forms, trading software)
* Excellent writing skills and able to produce detailed project documentation, business requirements documentation and specifications to drive successful development
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, and the proven ability to influence and communicate effectively across both internal and client stakeholders
* History of teamwork, willingness to roll up one’s sleeves and get the job done, and a desire to work in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment
* Experience managing technology integrations is a plus

  


**Benefits**



The base salary range for this role is $145,000 to $185,000\. iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full\-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).



We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday\-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

  



For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us Twitter: @icapitalnetwork \| Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us/recognition/

  



iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

**Responsibilities**


* Drive successful end\-to\-end integrations for new and existing iCapital clients including wealth managers and asset managers as well as third party data integrations with fund administrators and transfer agents.
* Provide program and project management expertise including framing the project, establishing detailed project plans, managing risk and driving accountability across internal and external stakeholders.
* Retain in depth understanding of the iCapital platform in order to lead or facilitate client discovery, requirements gathering, operating model and business process design, platform set\-up, testing, and rollout.
* Manage the overall platform experience for existing clients including maximizing their consumption of the platform.
* Build a strong understanding of a client’s business and how that translates to the iCapital platform.
* Provide Product Managers and other internal stakeholders with client context to assess change management activities including new product enhancements.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to identify product gaps and opportunities, vet potential solutions and roll out new features.
* Partner closely with the Product Management, Relationship Management, Sales, Operations, Client Success, and external technology teams to deliver for clients.


**Qualifications**


* 10\+ years of experience in project management, client software implementations, relationship management within financial services or fintech
* Knowledge of wealth management, alternative investments, and private bank business and processes
* Proven track record of leading cross\-functional project teams from inception to execution
* Familiar with software\-based financial solutions (transaction systems, online forms, trading software)
* Excellent writing skills and able to produce detailed project documentation, business requirements documentation and specifications to drive successful development
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, and the proven ability to influence and communicate effectively across both internal and client stakeholders
* History of teamwork, willingness to roll up one’s sleeves and get the job done, and a desire to work in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment
* Experience managing data integrations is a plus


**Benefits**



The base salary range for this role is $145,000 to $185,000\. iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full\-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).



We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday\-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.



For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us Twitter: @icapitalnetwork \| Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us/recognition/

  



iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Family****:**


Operational Effectiveness **Travel Required****:**


None **Clearance Required****:**


Ability to Obtain Public Trust**What You Will Do****:**


Guidehouse is seeking a Training Specialist to support training, technical assistance, and user adoption for a federal public health client. This role will design, develop, and deliver user\-centered training materials that help program staff, recipients, grantees, project sites, and stakeholders understand and use public health systems, tools, processes, reporting workflows, and data management guidance. The role may support CDC DHP\-related training and technical assistance for qualitative and quantitative data management, secure data submission, SOPs, data governance, and issue resolution.

* Develop training materials, curricula, job aids, user guides, FAQs, SOP training materials, and other support resources.
* Deliver training sessions, technical assistance, office\-hour support, and user support activities.
* Support adoption of public health systems, tools, processes, dashboards, data submission workflows, and reporting outputs.
* Support technical assistance for recipients, grantees, project sites, site coordinators, data managers, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with program, technical, and subject matter experts to ensure training content is accurate, useful, and aligned with approved procedures.
* Tailor training materials for different audiences, including client staff, recipients, grantees, project sites, and external stakeholders.
* Support stakeholder engagement, readiness, and change adoption activities related to public health data systems and reporting processes.
* Support issue intake, triage, documentation, escalation, and resolution processes for training and technical assistance needs.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements based on stakeholder feedback and recurring support needs.
* Maintain training documentation, trackers, support materials, and feedback summaries.
* Translate client needs into practical training products and user support deliverables.
* Deliver high\-quality client service in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.

 **What You Will Need****:**

* Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree.
* THREE (3\) years of relevant experience in training, instructional design, technical assistance, public health support, change adoption, or a related field.
* Experience developing training materials, job aids, user guides, FAQs, SOPs, or other user support resources.
* Experience delivering training, facilitating meetings, or supporting stakeholder learning activities.
* Strong facilitation, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret client needs and translate them into practical documents, materials, or deliverables.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and produce accurate, user\-centered materials under deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint or similar collaboration tools.

 **What Would Be Nice To Have****:**

* Strong preference for candidates located in the Houston, TX, San Antonio, TX, Atlanta, GA or Huntsville, AL areas.
* Experience supporting CDC, HHS, or another federal health agency.
* Experience supporting HIV prevention, public health data systems, technical assistance, or recipient\-facing public health programs.
* Experience supporting public health programs, recipients, grantees, cooperative agreement stakeholders, project sites, or data managers.
* Experience supporting system rollouts, user onboarding, help desk materials, office hours, or technical assistance models.
* Experience developing role\-based training materials, SOPs, FAQs, quick\-reference guides, secure submission guidance, or issue\-resolution materials.
* Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility, adult learning principles, plain language standards, or federal training material review processes.
* Experience evaluating training effectiveness or improving training materials based on stakeholder feedback.


The annual salary range for this position is $61,000\.00\-$101,000\.00\. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. **What We Offer****:**


Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.


Benefits include:

* Medical, Rx, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Personal and Family Sick Time \& Company Paid Holidays
* Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus
* Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Basic Life \& Supplemental Life
* Health Savings Account, Dental/Vision \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
* Short\-Term \& Long\-Term Disability
* Student Loan PayDown
* Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development \& Learning Opportunities
* Skills Development \& Certifications
* Employee Referral Program
* Corporate Sponsored Events \& Community Outreach
* Emergency Back\-Up Childcare Program
* Mobility Stipend

**About Guidehouse**


Guidehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer–Protected Veterans, Individuals with Disabilities or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.


Guidehouse will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable law or ordinance including the Fair Chance Ordinance of Los Angeles and San Francisco.


If you have visited our website for information about employment opportunities, or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Guidehouse Recruiting at 1\-571\-633\-1711 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@guidehouse.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodation.


All communication regarding recruitment for a Guidehouse position will be sent from Guidehouse email domains including @guidehouse.com or guidehouse@myworkday.com. Correspondence received by an applicant from any other domain should be considered unauthorized and will not be honored by Guidehouse. Note that Guidehouse will never charge a fee or require a money transfer at any stage of the recruitment process and does not collect fees from educational institutions for participation in a recruitment event. Never provide your banking information to a third party purporting to need that information to proceed in the hiring process.


If any person or organization demands money related to a job opportunity with Guidehouse, please report the matter to Guidehouse’s Ethics Hotline. If you want to check the validity of correspondence you have received, please contact recruiting@guidehouse.com. Guidehouse is not responsible for losses incurred (monetary or otherwise) from an applicant’s dealings with unauthorized third parties.

*Guidehouse does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Guidehouse and Guidehouse will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.*
